summary: Completed testing of Avatar Scene Type Switcher Feature. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verification confirmed all features working: type switcher dropdown with 5 options, avatar scene mockup with visual layout, conversion notice when type changed, and proper state management when reverting type.

GOOD: AvatarSceneMockup component shows visual layout with avatar position indicator (left/right/center), narration script, and background description
GOOD: CourseReviewPanel correctly manages typeOverrides state and propagates changes via onTypeOverride callback
GOOD: Conversion notice appears when avatar_scene type is changed to another type, showing appropriate message
GOOD: 'Alterado' badge appears on improvement cards when type has been changed from original
GOOD: Violet info banner shows count of avatar_scene suggestions with explanation about auto-generation
GOOD: Avatar settings collapsible section with maxScenes input (data-testid='avatar-limit-input')
GOOD: StoryboardPanel also supports type switching for avatar_scene slides in create mode
FIX APPLIED: Backend save-type-overrides endpoint now handles sessions without storyboard (was causing 500 error)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar Scene Type Switcher feature fully tested and working. Key components: SlideTypeSwitcher (dropdown with 5 options), AvatarSceneMockup (visual preview), CourseReviewPanel (Edit Mode), StoryboardPanel (Create Mode). Backend endpoints: POST /api/agent/sessions/{session_id}/save-type-overrides, GET/PUT /api/agent/projects/{project_id}/avatar-settings. The type override propagates to apply-improvements and affects avatarScenesTriggered count.
